name: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd
title: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd - 541154 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: FY26 revenue up 7% to INR33,050 crore with 30% EBITDA margin; LCA Mk1A deliveries slipped to Aug–Sep and FY27 guidance is only 10–12% growth, with 15–20 LCA deliveries dependent on GE engines.

utilisation.quote: Not a single production line is idle because we are continuously building the structures and equipping them.

capex.quote: We plan to invest around INR12,000 crores in these projects by 2030.

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth 10–12%
triggers.quote: Yes, it will be in the range of 10% to 12% minimum.

triggers.label: LCA deliveries hinge on GE engines
triggers.quote: June, we are expecting 1 engine now. Then afterwards, it is going to August. From August, they have committed 2.

triggers.label: Inventory up ~INR9,000 crore in FY26
triggers.quote: you've added about INR9,000-odd crores into your inventory this year.

triggers.label: LCA first deliveries slip to Aug–Sep
triggers.quote: we are hoping to resolve everything and stabilize by August or September.

guidance.quote: Yes, it will be in the range of 10% to 12% minimum.
And the EBITDA margin, we have always maintained around 30%, 31%, and it will be maintained.
we are planning to deliver around 20 LCA.
we are planning around 20 plus this year to deliver.
In total, we expect to receive orders of INR90,000 crores, including the ROH orders, during the next 2 years.
We plan to invest around INR12,000 crores in these projects by 2030.
